title: QMAP-Seq: Quantitative and Multiplexed Analysis of Phenotype by Sequencing
protocol: Thaw pooled cell lines in media containing 100 ng/mL doxycycline.
Expand cells and refresh doxycycline three days later.
Seed 5,000 pooled cells in a volume of 100 μL in 96-well plates while maintaining doxycycline induction.
Add compounds over a four-point concentration range in duplicate the next day.
Treat cells with compounds for 72 hours.
Thaw cell spike-in standards at room temperature for 5 minutes.
Resuspend cell spike-in standards in Lysis Buffer to achieve desired concentration.
Customize spike-in cell numbers for each experiment.
Homogenize cells using a 5 mL syringe and a 21G x 1” needle three times.
Continue homogenizing cells with a 27G x ½” needle three times.
Incubate cells in a 60°C water bath for 1 hour, pipetting up and down every 20 minutes.
Wash compound-treated cells with 100 mL PBS after 72 hours of treatment.
Add 50 mL Lysis Buffer containing the desired concentration of total cell spike-in standards/mL using multichannel pipet.
Cover plates with foil adhesive.
Incubate plates in a 60°C oven for 1 hour.
Transfer cell lysates to PCR plates using multichannel pipet.
Inactivate Proteinase K from Lysis Buffer at 95ºC for 15 minutes using thermocycler.
Set up PCRs to amplify a 359-367 bp fragment containing the sgRNA and cell line barcode with unique P5 and P7 primers for each well.
Transfer half of the PCR volume from each reaction to a second set of PCR plates.
Run PCRs in thermocycler at 94°C for 4 minutes.
Cycle the reactions through 94°C for 30 seconds, 60°C for 30 seconds, and 72°C for 30 seconds (repeat for a total of 29 cycles).
Incubate the reactions at 72°C for 15 minutes.
Hold the reactions at 4°C.
Recombine technical duplicates.
Run 5 μL of PCR products on E-Gel 96 2% Agarose gels to verify library size.
Pool an equal volume (6 μL) of each PCR product together.
Measure the concentration of the pooled PCR products using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Purify pooled PCR products using the QIAquick PCR Purification Kit with sufficient columns to avoid exceeding binding capacity.
Measure the concentration of the purified sample using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Purify the purified sample a second time using the Purification Module with Magnetic Beads.
Measure the final library concentration using the Qubit dsDNA HS Assay Kit.
Dilute the sequencing library to 2.5 nM.
Combine the sequencing library with PhiX to achieve 25% PhiX.
Denature the sequencing library according to Illumina specifications.
Load the sequencing library on a NovaSeq 6000 using a NovaSeq 6000 S1 Reagent Kit, 200 Cycles, 1.3B Reads.
Perform single-end sequencing with an Illumina Read 1 Primer of 164 bp read.
Perform single-end sequencing with an Illumina Index 1 Primer of 6 bp read.
Perform single-end sequencing with an Illumina Index 2 Primer of 6 bp read.
Demultiplex individual samples based on i5 and i7 index sequences by running bcl2fastq Conversion Software.
Extract sgRNA and cell line barcode sequences from Read 1 sequences.
Count the number of reads for each cell line-sgRNA pair.
Interpolate cell number from sequencing reads using sample-specific standard curves.
Normalize the number of cells for a compound-treated sample to the median number of cells for DMSO-treated samples.
